pcControls.tableQuote:
Left-Click, C: Use tool or place item
Right-Click, X: Check/Do Action
verifiedFacts: Check/Do Action (Right-Click, X): Safely hand-harvests mature crops with 0 energy
Use tool or place item (Left-Click, C): Uses equipped tool; swinging tool can destroy crops (axe/pickaxe) or waste energy; swings scythe if scythe is equipped
Continuous harvesting: Holding Right-Click or X and walking over crops continuously harvests; replants simultaneously if seeds are held; pitfall: holding edible food triggers eating prompt

consoleControls.tableQuote:
Xbox: A (Check / Do Action / Use Cursor), X (Use Tool)
PlayStation: Cross (Check / Do Action / Use Cursor), Square (Use Tool)
Switch: A (Check / Do Action / Use Cursor), Y (Use Tool)
verifiedFacts: Game does not define separate crop harvest buttons for controllers
Harvesting hand crops uses the general Check/Do Action button (A on Xbox, Cross on PS, A on Switch)
Tool use (Scythe) uses the general Use Tool button (X on Xbox, Square on PS, Y on Switch)

mobileControls.exactQuote: Tap on items to action them. Tapping on stones, wood, stumps, boulders, rocks etc will auto-select the correct tool for the job. The one exception with tools is the scythe, which must be selected to use.
verifiedFacts: Hand crops: Tapping ripe crops actions/harvests them
Scythe crops: Scythe must be manually selected before tapping/swinging
